newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-IRELAND HOLD ON TO BEAT WALES BY A POINT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-IRELAND HOLD ON TO BEAT WALES BY A POINT.

text.p: Ireland held off a spirited fightback by Wales to win their Five Nations' championship match 26-25 on Saturday and extend their unbeaten record in Cardiff to 14 years.
Former Welsh captain Ieuan Evans gave Wales a magnificent start with a try in the first minute and took his national record total to 33 with a second after the interval.
But tries to Jonathan Bell, Eric Miller and new cap Dennis Hickie helped Ireland to a 20-10 halftime lead and they held on grimly in the second half as the Welsh stormed on to the attack.
Number eight Scott Quinell scored Wales's third try three minutes from time but the homne side could not grab the crucial points to get their second win of the championship.
